reading: Independent re-derivation by the parallel track CONFIRMS the two load-bearing results of this one: k*d = n exactly, and the democratic Yukawa is rank 1 (one heavy generation). Three discrepancies were found, all resolved in favour of this track and re-verified here from the geometry: the BPT ratio is q+1 (so the codes need >=3 spatial dimensions, they are not 2D-local), the check weight is 2(q+1)=8 rather than q+1=4 (the weight-4 lines are logicals, not stabilisers), and the quantum Singleton bound is n-2(d-1). Cross-checking two agents is cheap and caught real errors.
